en: Hey there, friends! Welcome to our Hero Jesus, where Bible stories come to life!
zh: 嗨，朋友們！歡迎來到我們的英雄耶穌，這裡聖經故事栩栩如生！
ja: みなさん、こんにちは！ここは聖書の物語が生き生きと語られる「ヒーロー・ジーザス」へようこそ！
local: Hey there, friends! Welcome to our Hero Jesus, where Bible stories come to life!
native: Hey there, friends! Welcome to our Hero Jesus, where Bible stories come to life!

en: Mother's Day is such a special day.
zh: 母親節是如此特別的一天。
ja: 母の日はとても特別な日です。
local: Mother's Day is such a special day.
native: Mother's Day is such a special day.

en: Did you know the Bible is full of stories about incredible moms, brave women, full of love, and faith?
zh: 你知道聖經裡充滿了關於了不起的媽媽、勇敢的女性，充滿愛與信心的故事嗎？
ja: 聖書には素晴らしいお母さんたち、勇敢で愛と信仰に満ちた女性たちの物語がたくさんあることを知っていましたか？
local: Did you know the Bible is full of stories about incredible moms, brave women, full of love, and faith?
native: Did you know the Bible is full of stories about incredible moms, brave women, full of love, and faith?

en: Let's meet some of them and learn how we can celebrate our moms today.
zh: 讓我們來認識其中一些，並學習今天如何慶祝我們的媽媽。
ja: その中の何人かに会って、今日どのようにお母さんをお祝いできるか学びましょう。
local: Let's meet some of them and learn how we can celebrate our moms today.
native: Let's meet some of them and learn how we can celebrate our moms today.

en: Don't forget to smash that big thumbs up below, so more kids and families can learn about Jesus' love!
zh: 別忘了按下下面的大拇指讚，讓更多孩子和家庭能了解耶穌的愛！
ja: 下の大きないいねボタンを押すのを忘れないでね。そうすれば、もっと多くの子どもや家族がイエスの愛を知ることができます！
local: Don't forget to smash that big thumbs up below, so more kids and families can learn about Jesus' love!
native: Don't forget to smash that big thumbs up below, so more kids and families can learn about Jesus' love!

en: Now, grab your favorite pillow, get comfy on the couch, and come with me to meet these awesome Bible moms!
zh: 現在，拿起你最喜歡的枕頭，舒適地坐在沙發上，跟我一起去認識這些了不起的聖經媽媽們！
ja: さあ、お気に入りの枕を持ってソファでくつろぎながら、一緒に素敵な聖書のお母さんたちに会いに行きましょう！
local: Now, grab your favorite pillow, get comfy on the couch, and come with me to meet these awesome Bible moms!
native: Now, grab your favorite pillow, get comfy on the couch, and come with me to meet these awesome Bible moms!

en: The first mom will meet is Hannah, the woman who prayed with so much faith, that God changed her story.
zh: 我們要認識的第一位媽媽是哈拿，她以堅定的信心禱告，神改變了她的故事。
ja: 最初に会うお母さんはハンナです。彼女は強い信仰を持って祈り、神が彼女の人生を変えました。
local: The first mom will meet is Hannah, the woman who prayed with so much faith, that God changed her story.
native: The first mom will meet is Hannah, the woman who prayed with so much faith, that God changed her story.

en: Hannah really wanted to be a mom, but she couldn't have children.
zh: 哈拿非常想當媽媽，但她無法生育。
ja: ハンナは本当に母親になりたかったのですが、子どもを持つことができませんでした。
local: Hannah really wanted to be a mom, but she couldn't have children.
native: Hannah really wanted to be a mom, but she couldn't have children.

en: One day, she prayed with all her heart, and God gave her a son, Samuel.
zh: 有一天，她全心禱告，神賜給她一個兒子，撒母耳。
ja: ある日、彼女は心から祈り、神は彼女に息子サムエルを与えました。
local: One day, she prayed with all her heart, and God gave her a son, Samuel.
native: One day, she prayed with all her heart, and God gave her a son, Samuel.

en: Hannah's prayer was so powerful that God not only gave her Samuel, but turned him into a great prophet,
zh: 哈拿的禱告非常有力，神不僅賜給她撒母耳，還使他成為偉大的先知，
ja: ハンナの祈りはとても強力で、神はサムエルを与えただけでなく、彼を偉大な預言者にしました。
local: Hannah's prayer was so powerful that God not only gave her Samuel, but turned him into a great prophet,
native: Hannah's prayer was so powerful that God not only gave her Samuel, but turned him into a great prophet,

en: who led the entire nation of Israel.
zh: 他帶領了整個以色列國。
ja: 彼はイスラエルの全民族を導きました。
local: who led the entire nation of Israel.
native: who led the entire nation of Israel.

en: All because Hannah never gave up believing and dedicated her son to God, just like her.
zh: 這一切都是因為哈拿從未放棄信念，並將她的兒子獻給了神，就像她一樣。
ja: これはすべて、ハンナが信じることをあきらめず、息子を神に捧げたからです。
local: All because Hannah never gave up believing and dedicated her son to God, just like her.
native: All because Hannah never gave up believing and dedicated her son to God, just like her.

en: Our moms teach us to pray and trust God every day.
zh: 我們的媽媽教導我們每天禱告並信靠神。
ja: 私たちのお母さんは毎日祈り、神を信頼することを教えてくれます。
local: Our moms teach us to pray and trust God every day.
native: Our moms teach us to pray and trust God every day.

en: Did you know your mom prays for you every night?
zh: 你知道你的媽媽每晚都為你禱告嗎？
ja: あなたのお母さんが毎晩あなたのために祈っていることを知っていましたか？
local: Did you know your mom prays for you every night?
native: Did you know your mom prays for you every night?

en: She's a faith warrior.
zh: 她是信仰的戰士。
ja: 彼女は信仰の戦士です。
local: She's a faith warrior.
native: She's a faith warrior.

en: Next, let's meet Jotchabed, the moms who saved her baby in an amazing way.
zh: 接下來，讓我們認識約基別，那位以驚人方式拯救她嬰兒的媽媽。
ja: 次に、赤ちゃんを素晴らしい方法で救ったお母さん、ヨケベデに会いましょう。
local: Next, let's meet Jotchabed, the moms who saved her baby in an amazing way.
native: Next, let's meet Jotchabed, the moms who saved her baby in an amazing way.

en: Do you know who that baby was?
zh: 你知道那個嬰兒是誰嗎？
ja: その赤ちゃんが誰か知っていますか？
local: Do you know who that baby was?
native: Do you know who that baby was?

en: Jotchabed was Moses' mom.
zh: 約基別是摩西的媽媽。
ja: ヨケベデはモーセのお母さんでした。
local: Jotchabed was Moses' mom.
native: Jotchabed was Moses' mom.

en: When he was a baby, she hid him in a basket in the river to save him from a scary Pharaoh.
zh: 當他還是嬰兒時，她把他藏在河裡的籃子裡，救他免於可怕的法老。
ja: 彼が赤ちゃんの時、彼女は怖いファラオから守るために川の中のかごに隠しました。
local: When he was a baby, she hid him in a basket in the river to save him from a scary Pharaoh.
native: When he was a baby, she hid him in a basket in the river to save him from a scary Pharaoh.

en: God even used the Pharaoh's daughter to care for him.
zh: 神甚至使用法老的女兒來照顧他。
ja: 神はファラオの娘を使って彼の世話をさせました。
local: God even used the Pharaoh's daughter to care for him.
native: God even used the Pharaoh's daughter to care for him.

en: Years later, Moses grew up to become the great leader God used to free the Israelites from slavery.
zh: 多年後，摩西長大成為神用來解救以色列人脫離奴役的偉大領袖。
ja: 何年も後、モーセは成長し、神がイスラエル人を奴隷状態から解放するために用いた偉大な指導者になりました。
local: Years later, Moses grew up to become the great leader God used to free the Israelites from slavery.
native: Years later, Moses grew up to become the great leader God used to free the Israelites from slavery.

en: All because Jotchabed was brave, clever, and trusted God.
zh: 這一切都是因為約基別勇敢、聰明，並信靠神。
ja: これはすべて、ヨケベデが勇敢で賢く、神を信頼していたからです。
local: All because Jotchabed was brave, clever, and trusted God.
native: All because Jotchabed was brave, clever, and trusted God.

en: Just like her, our moms do everything to protect us and teach us to trust the Lord.
zh: 就像她一樣，我們的媽媽做一切來保護我們並教導我們信靠主。
ja: 彼女のように、私たちのお母さんも私たちを守り、主を信頼することを教えてくれます。
local: Just like her, our moms do everything to protect us and teach us to trust the Lord.
native: Just like her, our moms do everything to protect us and teach us to trust the Lord.

en: Have you ever thought about how much your mom does to take care of you?
zh: 你有沒有想過你的媽媽為照顧你做了多少事？
ja: お母さんがどれだけあなたの世話をしているか考えたことがありますか？
local: Have you ever thought about how much your mom does to take care of you?
native: Have you ever thought about how much your mom does to take care of you?

en: She's a superhero, right?
zh: 她是超級英雄，對吧？
ja: 彼女はスーパーヒーローですよね？
local: She's a superhero, right?
native: She's a superhero, right?

en: Last but not least, the most important mom in the whole Bible, Mary, the young woman who said
zh: 最後但同樣重要的是，整本聖經中最重要的媽媽，瑪利亞，那位年輕的女子說了
ja: 最後に、聖書の中で最も重要なお母さん、若い女性のマリアに会いましょう。彼女はこう言いました。
local: Last but not least, the most important mom in the whole Bible, Mary, the young woman who said
native: Last but not least, the most important mom in the whole Bible, Mary, the young woman who said

en: yes to God and became Jesus' mom.
zh: 對神說「是」，成為耶穌的媽媽。
ja: 神に「はい」と言い、イエスの母親になりました。
local: yes to God and became Jesus' mom.
native: yes to God and became Jesus' mom.

en: Mary was chosen by God to be Jesus' mother.
zh: 瑪利亞被神選中成為耶穌的母親。
ja: マリアは神に選ばれてイエスの母親になりました。
local: Mary was chosen by God to be Jesus' mother.
native: Mary was chosen by God to be Jesus' mother.

en: She said yes, even when she didn't understand everything.
zh: 即使她不完全明白，她仍說了「是」。
ja: すべてを理解していなくても、彼女は「はい」と言いました。
local: She said yes, even when she didn't understand everything.
native: She said yes, even when she didn't understand everything.

en: Mary could have been afraid, but she said yes to God and became the savior of the world's mom.
zh: 瑪利亞本可以害怕，但她對神說「是」，成為世界救主的母親。
ja: マリアは怖がっていたかもしれませんが、神に「はい」と言い、世界の救い主の母親になりました。
local: Mary could have been afraid, but she said yes to God and became the savior of the world's mom.
native: Mary could have been afraid, but she said yes to God and became the savior of the world's mom.

en: She cared for Jesus, watched him grow,
zh: 她照顧耶穌，看著他成長，
ja: 彼女はイエスの世話をし、成長を見守りました。
local: She cared for Jesus, watched him grow,
native: She cared for Jesus, watched him grow,

en: and never stopped trusting God.
zh: 並且從未停止信靠神。
ja: そして神を信頼し続けました。
local: and never stopped trusting God.
native: and never stopped trusting God.

en: She shows us that being a mom is a gift from God full of love and sacrifice.
zh: 她告訴我們，當媽媽是神賜予的充滿愛與犧牲的禮物。
ja: 彼女は、母親であることは愛と犠牲に満ちた神からの贈り物であることを示しています。
local: She shows us that being a mom is a gift from God full of love and sacrifice.
native: She shows us that being a mom is a gift from God full of love and sacrifice.

en: The Bible says, honor your father and mother.
zh: 聖經說，要孝敬父母。
ja: 聖書には「父と母を敬いなさい」と書かれています。
local: The Bible says, honor your father and mother.
native: The Bible says, honor your father and mother.

en: Honoring your mom means following her instructions, like tidying up your toys or doing homework.
zh: 孝敬媽媽意味著遵守她的指示，比如整理玩具或做功課。
ja: お母さんを敬うとは、例えばおもちゃを片付けたり宿題をしたりするなど、彼女の指示に従うことです。
local: Honoring your mom means following her instructions, like tidying up your toys or doing homework.
native: Honoring your mom means following her instructions, like tidying up your toys or doing homework.

en: Treating her with respect and kindness, no yelling or talking back.
zh: 以尊重和善良對待她，不大喊大叫或頂嘴。
ja: 尊敬と優しさをもって接し、怒鳴ったり反抗したりしないことです。
local: Treating her with respect and kindness, no yelling or talking back.
native: Treating her with respect and kindness, no yelling or talking back.

en: Doing this not just on Mother's Day, but every day.
zh: 這不僅是母親節要做的事，而是每天都要這樣做。
ja: これは母の日だけでなく、毎日行うことです。
local: Doing this not just on Mother's Day, but every day.
native: Doing this not just on Mother's Day, but every day.

en: When you do this, your mom will be so happy and God will be proud of you.
zh: 當你這樣做時，你的媽媽會非常高興，神也會為你感到驕傲。
ja: これをすると、お母さんはとても喜び、神もあなたを誇りに思います。
local: When you do this, your mom will be so happy and God will be proud of you.
native: When you do this, your mom will be so happy and God will be proud of you.

en: How about giving her a big hug and a special card this Mother's Day saying,
zh: 今年母親節，給她一個大大的擁抱和一張特別的卡片，說：
ja: 今年の母の日に、大きなハグと特別なカードを贈ってみませんか？
local: How about giving her a big hug and a special card this Mother's Day saying,
native: How about giving her a big hug and a special card this Mother's Day saying,

en: mom, I love you and thank God for you.
zh: 媽媽，我愛你，感謝神有你。
ja: お母さん、愛しています。神様があなたを与えてくれてありがとう。
local: mom, I love you and thank God for you.
native: mom, I love you and thank God for you.

en: God blessed each of us with a special mom.
zh: 神賜福給我們每個人一位特別的媽媽。
ja: 神様は私たち一人ひとりに特別なお母さんを祝福してくださいました。
local: God blessed each of us with a special mom.
native: God blessed each of us with a special mom.

en: Let's pray together.
zh: 讓我們一起禱告。
ja: 一緒にお祈りしましょう。
local: Let's pray together.
native: Let's pray together.

en: Dear God, thank you for my mom.
zh: 親愛的神，感謝祢賜給我媽媽。
ja: 親愛なる神様、私の母に感謝します。
local: Dear God, thank you for my mom.
native: Dear God, thank you for my mom.

en: Bless her with health, joy, and wisdom.
zh: 賜福她健康、喜樂與智慧。
ja: 彼女に健康と喜び、知恵をお与えください。
local: Bless her with health, joy, and wisdom.
native: Bless her with health, joy, and wisdom.

en: Help me obey and love her every day.
zh: 幫助我每天順服並愛她。
ja: 私が毎日彼女に従い、愛することができますように。
local: Help me obey and love her every day.
native: Help me obey and love her every day.

en: In Jesus' name, amen.
zh: 奉耶穌的名禱告，阿們。
ja: イエスの御名によって、アーメン。
local: In Jesus' name, amen.
native: In Jesus' name, amen.
